items.modelResponse: Online access is flexible but excludes some users; mixed access adds support but may require travel (social). Translation and feedback broaden participation without proving consensus (cultural). Compare electricity with paper/travel (environmental), privacy and voluntary disclosure (ethical), and lower versus higher cost (economic). I first favoured lower cost; the new access concern supports private mixed access, with remaining travel limits. Hormone measurement enabled feedback tests and development of signal-based methods; demand for conception control helped direct that research. Neither programme choice proves individual treatment suitability.

Address all five dimensions with table evidence, respond to the new access/privacy concern, and explain both directions between research and societal need. Do not equate a lower cost or preferred format with biological effectiveness.

items.prompt: A fictional information service reports 12 live births, 30 embryo transfers and 50 initiated cycles. It proposes a short headline, “40% success”, to meet demand for understandable information. Calculate both live-birth percentages and repair the headline. Explain how IVF can expand capability for a transport problem without guaranteeing later development. Use the five requests in the table to compare the short headline with a fuller explanation. After considering the budget objection, revise the communication plan or justify retaining it. Do not recommend a treatment or rank family forms.

Invite feedback about wording and family roles without assuming one shared view
Consider paper, device and travel resource use
State uncertainty, avoid misleading denominators and do not request private family histories

items.modelResponse: 12/30=40% per transfer; 12/50=24% per initiated cycle. Report both with the live-birth endpoint. IVF moves fertilization outside the body and may bypass a transport barrier; transfer does not ensure implantation or birth. Clear access supports social needs; feedback respects differing cultural views; paper/device/travel use matters environmentally; honest denominators and privacy matter ethically; staffed support costs more economically. I retain the full explanation but use a concise two-rate notice with optional private support to address cost. Its accessibility and cost still need evaluation.
items.comparisonFeedback: Both denominators and the live-birth endpoint must remain explicit. Connect IVF to the changed step, address every perspective and show how the budget objection affects the proposal. Several plans can be defensible; a preferred communication plan is not proof of treatment effectiveness.
